Bracco is an international Group active in the healthcare sector and a leader in diagnostic imaging. The Group’s main products are contrast agents sold in over 100 countries, both directly and indirectly through branches, joint ventures and license and distribution agreements.
About the Role: 
We are looking for a Medical Device Specialist to support the development of our ACIST Medical devices (Injector, IVUS and FFR) business across all of Switzerland. In this field-based role, you will combine commercial, clinical, and technical expertise to promote innovative medical devices and support healthcare professionals in optimizing their use. 
You will work closely with Cardiologists, nurses, biomedical engineers, and hospital decision-makers, providing product demonstrations, application support, training, and commercial guidance.
Key Activities 
Sales & Business Development
